answer: The strongest single control I know for this is proof of location via earthquake P-wave timing, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Cloning 454 keys multiplies the price 454-fold: 41768 POA locked, or 7718 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. One wander of signal, one ember of cost, one whisper of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
